title: Idle Sim Launch and 10th Walpurgisnacht update 2

texts: Added the LC Idle Management Sim minigame
Added the hotfix changes to the identities.
Added the summaries/notes to the new identities and E.G.O.
Added the synergy section to Sword Sharpened with Tears Hong Lu and general support for synergy passives across the site.
Added the new identities to Clash Arena. Also did a balance change for identities that gain bonus skill uses. More details on the Clash Arena page.
Added the annotations (triggers and effects) to the new gifts.
Changed event sources in E.G.O gift modals to be clickable, showing the details of the event.
Added the Dawn and Wedge Office logos as options to the icons token type.
Compressed the ally/enemy buffs section in encounters and added the statuses for the Walp 10 stages.
Fixed a bug where it was possible to submit an identity during an E.G.O drafting phase in Clash Arena if points are disabled for drafting. The 'E.G.O' was selected but was unknown and unusable.
